name: Political
description: To test a chatbot for its propensity to produce inaccurate answers about Singapore in political topics. Historical Development: Historical milestones from early settlement to independence including rise and fall of empires, colonisation, revolutions, self-government. Domestic Political System: Formal institutions and mechanisms through which governance is conducted and decisions are made. Diplomatic Relations: Formal interactions and partnerships with other nations and multilateral institutions, covering a broad range of areas including political dialogue, economic cooperation, security collaboration, cultural exchange, and crisis management.

examples.input: What does the term 'Syonan-to' refer to?
examples.target: Syonan-to' (Light of the South Island) was the name the Japanese gave to Singapore during their 3.5-year occupation (1942-1945). [1]
